mission: Dissect the two immutable R10 exact existential bridge relations without inventing a solver. Determine which structural representation languages exactly preserve the target invariant I_F(B)=EXISTS Y F(Y,B), which fail, and what exact same-variable CNF width is minimally sufficient on these two finite interfaces.
target_invariant_I: For each frozen bridge assignment b, whether the preserved GENERAL_CNF frame has any internal extension y satisfying F(y,b).
must_preserve: membership of every bridge assignment in I_F
may_distort: solver work used by post-candidate shadow witness
must_destroy_or_ignore: post-hoc cherry-picking of only attractive structural probes
reference_frame: R10 frozen exact bridge truth relation for worlds 3 and 7
negative_control: deterministic non-class relation expected to fail at least the simple Schaefer/cardinality tests
falsifier: Any structural fingerprint that fails exact replay against the frozen truth relation, or any claimed exact CNF width smaller than a witnessed disallowed assignment's minimum distinguishing projection.
multiplicity_rule: All preregistered probes are reported. No probe may be silently dropped because its answer is unattractive.
unknown_rule: If a representation family is not exactly characterized, report OPEN/NOT_ESTABLISHED; do not infer minimality across untested languages.
frozen_probes: prime implicates and exact same-variable CNF width
renamable-Horn and renamable-dual-Horn using prime-implicate constraints
exact direct-product factorization over bridge variable partitions
GF(2) algebraic normal form degree and monomial sparsity
Hamming-1 geometry of the allowed relation
bounded-width hull sizes for every width from 1 through bridge size
exact_minimality_boundary: R11 may prove the minimum CNF clause width over the SAME bridge variables by exhaustive finite projection geometry. It must NOT call that the globally minimal representation language, minimum circuit, minimum extended formulation, or polynomial kernel.
shadow_policy: Finite bridge enumeration and exact DPLL are permitted only to reconstruct the already-frozen R10 witness relation for microscopy. They have no theorem or routing authority.
